data.text:
Phew... Swinging in a hammock in the tropics. Seriously chill...
I'm exhausted from the pool earlier, so times like this are an absolute must.
How about you? Are you getting proper rest?
Look, traveling all the way to the tropics with me—it doesn't get any more refreshing than this! Just kidding!
Huh, what's with that expression...? Oh, I know! You wanna play with me!
But as much as I wanna do that, the hammock won't let me go...
Ahaha, I'm just messing around. So, whatcha wanna play?
Are you all sweating enough?! Make some noise~!
Sunglasses are an absolute must in this sunshine. How do I look? Good, right?
Wait, hold up. Getting out of a hammock is hard! Gimme a hand?
When you think summer, you think 'bout me, right? Huh? 'Cause it's in my name? As in Towa-"summer"... C'mon, say something!
Whoa, you're sweaty! You must've been having tons of fun~ Here, use this towel!
Aren't you glad I came with you? Hehe, you enjoyed it! It's written all over your face that you had fun~♪

Mmm, yummy! Nothing beats listening to the waves while eating ramen.
Man, I'm glad there was a beach shack in just the right spot~
Huh, the seaweed shape? Oh, this? All right, I have a confession.
Truth is, I'm doing a collab with this beach shack. Aaand since we were nearby, I wanted you to try it.
So, let's go ahead and eat up!
I did just have a food binge recently, but I've already decided I'm eating today!
Excuse me, another serving of noodles, please!
All right, let's have a blast and do everything you guys wanna do this summer!
Say, this straw hat is giving off some serious summer vibes~♪
If I eat ramen while sweating this much, it's basically zero calories, right?
The glare off the beach is nuts! I'll turn into a nicely roasted lion at this rate...
Take this, water attack! I'm always on target!
The sky is turning red. We might as well watch until the sun sets.

Well? Do you like the spot I picked?
There's shade, the water's nearby, there's no people... How good I am for finding it?
Haah, and it's nice to take it easy every now and then, huh?
I was at the beach not too long ago, and it was just one activity after another.
I mean, that can be fun too, but...it's sooo much more relaxing to just exist.
Although we did come all this way... We should probably do at least something with ourselves.
Yeah. Let's do something. But in a bit. For now, we rest.
Well, you heard me. Now we relax! ♪
Your cheers, combined with our songs are gonna set this summer stage totally ablaze!
It's so much easier to move around in a swimsuit, huh? Um, excuse me? It's my swimsuit you should be checking out...
The heat doesn't bother me. I got a great night's sleep... Yes. I slept.
All right. We're staying at the beach till dawn! Just kidding! Did you fall for it?
Want some fruit? Some juice? Gotta keep your nutrition up in all this heat.
Whee! That was fun! Let's come back to the beach sometime. And you can leave all the planning to me, of course.

Biboo's Sand Castle is almost done!
But we can make even better! I'm gonna decorate it with more gorgeous stones and make it super sparkly!
Alright, time for a gem-hunting quest!
Of course I am in charge. I was the captain during our last beach visit too, so trust me!
...Huh, you think I'm not capable? Hey, I won't accept that!
Then let's compete to see who can find the more beautiful stones!
I'll show you who the real captain is! Gwaaaaaaah!
I must not be outshined by the summer sun's glow! Kira Kira Koseki!
Hehe, isn't Bijou's swimsuit cute? Yaaay, thanks!
What's inside this pouch is...a secret! I won't tell you!
Ahhh, what a gorgeous stone?! I found it first! It belongs to meee!
Yaaaay, I won! From now on, you'll call me Captain Biboo, okay?!
Whew, that was so much fun! Let's go exploring again, okay? It's a promise~
Sweating is a sign of hard work!
Are you ready to get so hot you'll melt?!
Let's eat some ramen and power through the summer together!
Come enjoy this hot summer with me! Whee!♪
Yay! Let's go wild on the summer stage with me!
Come here, summer heat! I'll be your opponent!
Don't let the heat get to you, Towa! Mental! Physical! Passion!
I was just looking 'cause you were striking those cute poses!
Hey, everyone! Are you getting so fired up you can't even think straight anymore?
Botan-chan, your straw hat really gives off that summer vibe.
I can't help but feel your hunter eyes on me...
Eat too much and you'll get brain freeze~♪
Let's cool things down with a chill song from me!
Blame it on the summer and let's paaaarty!
Let's blow away the summer heat~!
Subaru-chan, you keep staring at me~
Check out these sunglasses. Cool, right?
I'm partying soooo much, I might just evaporate!
Waugh! Nene, don't cuddle up to me, it's hot!
Are you all sweating enough?! Make some noise~!
Phew! All this dripping sweat suits you just fine, Towawa~♪
Let's flaunt our super-lovely burning bond~♡
Huh? Lemme guess, you wanna wear it, Peko-chan?
Watame-san?! It's rude to keep staring like this!
You gotta eat energy food in summer.
Eating shaved ice is even better when it's hot.
Could somebody nerf the summer heat already?
Only if you're treating me to some good ol' beach shack ramen!
Shade is a godsend, so make sure to secure some!
All right, let's have a blast and do everything you guys wanna do this summer!
I thank the heavens for delighting us with this summer season!
Hey, honey! Wanna go on a date with me?
I hate that it's getting constantly buffed in the recent patch notes...
Everyone, please be careful with your health!
Anyone not having fun will get buried in the sand!
Alright alright, I'll put sunscreen on you!
Yes, please. You can put it on me, Ela!♪
Thank you! Your love's hotter than summer!
Oh? You don't want a drink? Then hurry up and give it back.
Mikochi! That shoots water for the theatrics!
And you don't like the sun, right, Zeta? Shall I lend you my hat?
I'm a tough one. The heat's got nothing on me.
Well? What do you think? Sunglasses are a necessity for summer.
Sounds good. Cannot wait. We'll build it so big you have to crane your neck!
Your cheers, combined with our songs are gonna set this summer stage totally ablaze!
Are you ready to go wild? Bijou, go go go go go!
Okay okay, how's this? You're a lil' cute troublemaker.
Ooh! Me neither! I'm a strong cookie!
Ela, Ela! I wanna build a sandcastle on the beach!
Otsukaresummer only in summer~ Just kidding!
Hold up! Your bag is gaping open!
Anyone not having fun will be buried in the sand like a zombie!
Yeah! Let's blow away this summer heat!
Huh? Hey Calli, what's that supposed to mean?
Biboo wanna sunbathe at the beach~
HA HA HA! Raise your hand if you don't wanna get drenched!
Everyone, make a big wave for me! Let's go!
Everyone, look look! Biboo in a swimsuit!
Thanks! You can even toss it around like a frisbee!
I must not be outshined by the summer sun's glow! Kira Kira Koseki!
Biboo! That straw hat is perfect for you!
